subject: [PATCH v4 4/8] mm/mmzone: read each zoneref slot once when filtering by nodemask

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug where the kernel dereferences a NULL pointer when filtering zones by nodemask. The problem occurs because the code reads each zoneref slot twice, once to check if it's NULL and again to look up its node. This can cause an oops when the second read returns the terminator after offlining a zone's last block. To fix this, the patch reads each slot only once and checks the zone directly. A NULL zone still terminates the walk as expected.
